LETTER OF APPOINTMENT

Arjun Rao, you are offered the position of Software Engineer at Brightpath Systems Private Limited, based at our Bengaluru office.

1. Joining
1.1 Your date of joining is 3 November 2026. You will report to the Engineering Manager, Platform Team.

2. Compensation
2.1 Your annual cost to company is Rs. 9,00,000, made up of basic salary, house rent allowance, special allowance and employer provident fund contribution. A detailed salary breakup is attached as Annexure A.

3. Probation
3.1 You will be on probation for three (3) months. Probation may be extended once, by no more than three further months, with written reasons.

4. Leave
4.1 You are entitled to eighteen (18) days of paid leave in each calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

5. Notice Period
5.1 After confirmation, either party may end this employment by giving thirty (30) days written notice to the other, or salary in lieu of notice.

6. Confidentiality
6.1 You shall keep confidential all non-public information about the Company and its clients, during and after your employment. General skills and knowledge you gain are not confidential information.

7. Outside Work
7.1 During your employment you shall not work for a competitor of the Company. You may undertake unrelated personal projects outside working hours.

8. Governing Law
8.1 This letter is governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Bengaluru shall have jurisdiction.
